{{Short description|none}}
The '''2024 Copa Sudamericana final stages''' were played from 16 July to 23 November 2024.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/las-fechas-para-tener-en-cuenta-en-los-torneos-de-clubes/|title=Calendario de la CONMEBOL Libertadores y CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2024|trans-title=2024 CONMEBOL Libertadores and CONMEBOL Sudamericana schedule|publisher=CONMEBOL|language=es|date=30 November 2023|access-date=15 May 2024}}</ref> A total of 24 teams competed in the final stages to decide the champions of the [[2024 Copa Sudamericana]],<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/Manual-de-Clubes-CS-2024-ESP-Digital.pdf|title=Manual de Clubes CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2024|publisher=CONMEBOL|language=es|date=13 December 2023|access-date=15 May 2024}}</ref> with the final played at [[Estadio General Pablo Rojas]] in [[Asunción]], Paraguay.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/asuncion-y-santa-cruz-sedes-confirmadas-para-finales-de-la-conmebol-sudamericana/ |title=¡Asunción y Santa Cruz recibirán a la Gran Conquista! |trans-title=Asunción and Santa Cruz will host the Great Conquest! |publisher=CONMEBOL |language=es |date=10 April 2024 |access-date=15 May 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.directvsports.com/futbol/Alejandro-Dominguez-confirmo-que-la-final-de-la-Sudamericana-se-juega-en-la-Nueva-Olla-20241007-0044.html |title=Alejandro Domínguez confirmó que la final de la Sudamericana se jugará en La Nueva Olla |trans-title=Alejandro Domínguez confirmed that the Sudamericana final will be played at La Nueva Olla |publisher=[[DSports]] |language=es |date=7 October 2024 |access-date=23 October 2024}}</ref>

==Qualified teams==
The winners and runners-up of each of the eight groups in the [[2024 Copa Sudamericana group stage|Copa Sudamericana group stage]] as well as the third-placed teams of each of the eight groups in the [[2024 Copa Libertadores group stage|Copa Libertadores group stage]] advanced to the final stages. The eight Copa Sudamericana group runners-up faced the eight Copa Libertadores group third-placed teams in the knockout round play-offs, whilst the eight Copa Sudamericana group winners directly advanced to the round of 16.<section begin=Qualified teams />

===Seeding===
<section begin=Seeding />
For the final stages, the teams were seeded according to their results in the group stage, with the Copa Sudamericana group winners seeded 1–8, the Copa Sudamericana group runners-up seeded 9–16, and the Copa Libertadores group third-placed teams seeded 17–24. For the round of 16 draw, the seeds 1–8 made up Pot 1, and the eight knockout round play-offs winners (seeds 9–24) made up Pot 2, keeping their seed. Teams from the same association could play each other from the knockout round play-offs onwards.

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
Starting from the knockout round play-offs, the teams played a [[single-elimination tournament]] with the following rules:<ref name="regulations"/>
*In the knockout round play-offs, round of 16, quarter-finals and semi-finals, each tie was played on a home-and-away [[two-legged tie|two-legged]] basis, with the higher-seeded team hosting the second leg (Regulations Article 2.2.3). If tied on aggregate, [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] would not be played, and a [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] was used to determine the winners (Regulations Article 2.4.4).
*The final was played as a single match at a venue pre-selected by CONMEBOL, with the higher-seeded team designated as the "home" team for administrative purposes (Regulations Article 2.2.6). If tied after regulation, 30 minutes of [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] would be played. If still tied after extra time, a [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] would be used to determine the winners (Regulations Article 2.4.5).<section end=Format />

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw />
The draw for the round of 16 was held on 3 June 2024, 12:00 [[Time in Paraguay|PYT]] ([[UTC−04:00|UTC−4]]) in [[Asunción]], Paraguay.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.futbolred.com/copa-libertadores/confirmada-la-fecha-del-sorteo-de-octavos-de-final-de-la-copa-libertadores-y-copa-sudamericana-209353|title=¿Estarán colombianos? Fecha del sorteo de octavos de torneos Conmebol|trans-title=Will Colombians be there? Date for the Round of 16 draw of CONMEBOL tournaments|publisher=Futbolred|language=es|date=29 April 2024|access-date=15 May 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/pautas-de-sorteo-para-octavos-de-final/|title=Pautas de sorteo para Octavos de Final|trans-title=Draw guidelines for the Round of 16|publisher=CONMEBOL|language=es|date=31 May 2024|access-date=1 June 2024}}</ref> For the round of 16, the 16 teams were drawn into eight ties (A–H) between a Copa Sudamericana group winner (Pot 1) and a knockout round play-offs winner (Pot 2), with the group winners hosting the second leg. Teams from the same association or the same group could be drawn into the same tie (Regulations Article 2.2.3.2).<ref name="regulations"/><section end=Draw />

==Knockout round play-offs==
===Summary===

==Round of 16==
===Summary===
The first legs were played on 13–15 August, and the second legs were played on 20–22 August 2024.<ref name="R16 fixture">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/fixture-de-los-octavos-de-final/|title=Fixture de los Octavos de Final|trans-title=Fixture for the Round of 16|language=es|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=26 July 2024|access-date=26 July 2024}}</ref><ref name="R16 fixture pdf">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/Fixture-Sudamericana_Octavos-de-Final_2024.pdf|title=CONMEBOL SUDAMERICANA 2024 {{!}} PROGRAMA DE PARTIDOS - PLAYOFFS OCTAVOS DE FINAL {{!}} Departamento de Competiciones y Operaciones {{!}} 26/7/2024|language=es|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=26 July 2024|access-date=26 July 2024}}</ref>
